name: Stanford CARE Explorers: AI x Precision Health
org: Stanford Center for Asian Health Research and Education
what_you_do: This is a two-week in-person summer program. It covers health topics that affect Asian communities. You learn AI basics and leadership skills. You also learn about precision health data.
who_can_apply: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors who are at least 14 and can commute daily to the Palo Alto campus. You need a laptop.
pay_detail: 2026 fee was $5,500; 2027 fee not announced. Limited need-based aid in 2026.
duration: 2 weeks (2026 sessions: June 15 to 26 and July 6 to 17)
deadline_text: 2027 dates will be announced in fall 2026. Sign up for announcements.
how_to_apply: Sign up for application announcements on the CARE page; email carehighschoolprogram@stanford.edu.
notes: Pay-to-play. Day program, about 9am to 3pm on weekdays. No housing or transportation provided; lunch and snacks included. No application fee waivers in 2026.
